facts.text: The warning-system fleet is the set of machines the manufacturer has already sold with the proximity warning system; its field history records what those machines detected, warned about and got wrong in real use.
facts.quote: The warning-system fleet is the set of machines the manufacturer has already sold with the proximity warning system, and its field history is the record of what those machines have detected, warned about and got wrong in real use.

facts.text: Before any prototype of the new system exists, the manufacturer already has field machines with sensors watching their surroundings. The existing warning-system fleet is treated as the program's most valuable early asset, subject to conditions.
facts.quote: Before any prototype of the new system exists, the manufacturer already has machines in the field with sensors watching their surroundings. The booklet treats this fleet as the program's most valuable early asset, with conditions.

facts.text: The existing warning-system fleet can start recording in October 2026, including through the winter that the later validation window will not cover.
facts.quote: the existing machines can start recording now, in October 2026, including through the winter that the later validation window will never see

facts.text: Replaying warning-system fleet recordings through new software measures detection and false-alarm behavior on real data.
facts.quote: Replaying those recordings through new software measures detection and false-alarm behavior on real data

facts.text: The warning-system fleet's recorded false-alarm history is the best available data for setting intervention thresholds.
facts.quote: the recorded false-alarm history is the best available data for setting intervention thresholds

facts.text: The warning-system fleet is the natural source for an exposure model, and estimating the exposure distribution from the fleet should start now.
facts.quote: The fleet is also the natural source for an exposure model, and the booklet says estimating that distribution from it should start now

facts.text: The existence of a warning system is established, but retention of raw sensor data, machine signals, accurate time stamps or labels by that system is not established.
facts.quote: what is established is that a warning system exists, not that it keeps raw sensor data, machine signals, accurate time stamps or labels.

facts.text: A warning-system fleet record worth replaying needs raw sensor data, machine signals, accurate time stamps, labels and an independent record of what was really there.
facts.quote: raw sensor data, machine signals, accurate time stamps or labels. A record worth replaying needs all of these plus an independent record of what was really there

facts.text: Labeling dominates the cost of preparing warning-system fleet records worth replaying.
facts.quote: A record worth replaying needs all of these plus an independent record of what was really there; labeling dominates the cost

facts.text: Warning-system fleet field history can validate inputs and parts of the simulation, but cannot validate the new closed-loop braking chain.
facts.quote: field history can validate inputs and parts of the simulation, not the new closed-loop braking chain.

facts.text: Warning-system fleet logs are open-loop because the world did not react to the new software.
facts.quote: The logs are open-loop (the world did not react to the new software)

facts.text: Warning-system fleet logs are censored by operator responses: a warning that caused the operator to brake hides what would otherwise have happened.
facts.quote: censored by the operator (a warning that made the operator brake hides what would have happened otherwise)

facts.text: Warning-system fleet logs are biased toward normal operation.
Starting warning-system fleet recording now is an unconditional recommendation because the fleet's winter data cannot be collected later.
facts.quote: "Start recording now" is one of the few unconditional recommendations in the booklet, because the fleet's winter data cannot be collected later

facts.text: The baseline that the new system must beat can only be measured from the warning-system fleet.
facts.quote: the baseline the new system must beat can only be measured from it
